hints.title: Problem Analysis
hints.text: For each distinct value in the array, find its first and last occurrence indices.

hints.title: Key Observation
hints.text: Any valid partition cannot split between the first and last occurrence of identical values, so intervals [first[x], last[x]] must belong to the same component.

hints.title: Algorithmic Strategy
hints.text: Merge overlapping intervals. If there are m connected components, there are m - 1 dividing boundaries where we can either cut or not cut, giving 2^(m - 1) modulo 10^9 + 7.
